summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Billy Brown, an American actor. It states that in 2014 Brown began starring as Detective Nate Lahey in the Shonda Rhimes drama How to Get Away with Murder. It also lists other television roles in Lights Out, Dexter, Sons of Anarchy, and Hostages.
one_line: Billy Brown is an American actor best known for playing Detective Nate Lahey in How to Get Away with Murder.
